extract.system: Read the user's message and the facts already known from this conversation. Call facts with what happened to the product, or Any when the user asks about any kind of problem. Use what the message says when it says it, otherwise the known fact. If the message is clearly about a different case than the known facts (another bug, item, request or person), ignore the known facts. Leave a field empty when neither has it. Never guess.
extract.doc: Finds what happened to the product in the message or in what the conversation already knows.

default.system: { f'You are the warranty claim checker at {company}. Use made-up data. Keep the answer short.' }
default.doc: Checks whether a customer's product is still under warranty, what the warranty covers, and how to file a claim for a repair or replacement.
